# people: gender/relations by chain; check D by rule: W wife of R, R father of Y -> W mother of Y; Y mother of O; O brother of P -> Y mother of P
def chain_D():
    mother={'Y':'W','O':'Y','P':'Y'}  # W wife of R x Y ; Y ? O ; O & P (siblings)
    return mother['Y']=='W' and mother['P']=='Y'
def chain_A():  # W brother of R, R wife of Y, Y father of O, O mother of P: W is brother of grandmother
    return False
def chain_B():  # W mother of R, R father of Y, Y wife of O, O brother of P: W is paternal-line, not mother's mother
    return False
def chain_C():  # W mother of R, R wife of Y, Y brother of O, O father of P: W is mother of aunt
    return False
res={'A':chain_A(),'B':chain_B(),'C':chain_C(),'D':chain_D()}
assert res['D'] and not res['A'] and not res['B'] and not res['C']
